function.description: The API returns configurations for a deployed layer 2 feature on a wired device.
function.name: api_getConfigurationsForADeployedLayer2FeatureOnAWiredDevice

feature.description: Name of the feature to retrieve Layer 2 configuration for. The API /dna/intent/api/v1/networkDevices/{id}/configFeatures/supported/layer2 can be used to get the list of features supported on a device.

id.description: Network device ID of the wired device to retrieve configuration for.
